description: This PHP source file defines the RequestResetPasswordController class responsible for handling password reset requests in the OrangeHRM authentication module. It includes methods for validating CSRF tokens, searching for the user, and redirecting the user based on the password reset request outcome.

classes.name: RequestResetPasswordController
classes.description: Controller class that handles password reset requests, including CSRF validation, user search, and redirection.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ResetPasswordService instance used for password reset operations.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the password reset request, verifies CSRF token, finds user, logs reset request, and redirects accordingly.
